text:
sara_sales: Heads up — Procurement sent back the POC order form with three redlines: net60, PO required, and tax ID verification. Also legal flagged a DPA carveout. Need routing & quick decisions.

julia_revops: Can you drop the latest doc here? I don't want to pull from email.

sara_sales: Link: https://redwood.docs/poc/ACME-POC/attachments — order_form_v3.pdf + procurement_comments.pdf. Key procurement ask: countersign via their vendor portal and separate invoicing flow.

mike_legal: Uploading a quick redline now. Biggest DPA items: they want explicit deletion-on-request + a mandatory subprocessor list that our standard DPA doesn't enumerate. Also they propose a 1-year data retention cap for logs.

laura_security: Security flags: they require SOC2 report and confirmation that KMS keys remain in their region. SOC2 link we can share, but KMS residency requires Private or Dedicated option.

tim_engineer: POC infra-wise we can offer Private deployment to satisfy KMS residency. That will change TCO — need to run numbers for Dedicated vs hosted.

sara_sales: Procurement also insists e-sign flow must allow 3 internal approvers (Sourcing -> Legal -> Finance) and prefer DocuSign. Any objections to DocuSign? Also asking for W9/tax forms.

mike_legal: DocuSign is fine if envelope routing explicitly includes our countersign mailbox (legal@redwood.com). I'll add limited-liability cap and standard indemnities in the redline. We should push back on the 1yr log retention; propose 3 years for audit data.

julia_revops: Finance won't sign off on net60 without a backup. Proposed options: (A) net30 + deposit, (B) net60 with a one-time refundable security deposit, or (C) net60 with a 1.5% finance fee. Which does sales want to present?

sara_sales: Customer says no deposit. They're sensitive to cashflow. Can we compromise on net45? Need an internal OK to offer net45 for this POC only.

mike_legal: I can accept net45 for the POC if we add a late fee clause and update invoice calendar language. I'll draft that and the DPA carveout response.

laura_security: I uploaded SOC2 summary + a KMS note to the drive. Text to include for customers: "Hosted: KMS in us-west-2 under Redwood-managed service. Private deployments: customer-managed KMS/HSM supported; addendum required."

esign-bot: Envelope created: envelopeId=env_3429982, routing order set to: sourcing -> finance -> legal -> redwood-countersign. Preview: https://esign.redwood/envelope/env_3429982

sara_sales: :thumbsup: Next steps — Mike will update the order form redline (MSA + DPA + net45 clause), Julia to confirm finance fallback language, Laura to send the security pack link to procurement, Tim to estimate private deployment delta. I'll update customer and request confirmation on net45 and DocuSign flow. cc @mike_legal @julia_revops @laura_security

mike_legal: Working on the redline now. Expect a draft in ~2 hours.

julia_revops: I'll run the net45 payment path with finance and reply here within the day.

tim_engineer: I'll add estimated cost delta for Private vs Hosted in the doc. Should have numbers by EOD.

Code snippet (envelope routing example):
```
{
  "envelopeId": "env_3429982",
  "routing": ["sourcing@acme.com", "finance@acme.com", "legal@acme.com", "countersign@redwood.com"],
  "signingOrder": "sequential"
}
```

sara_sales: Thanks team — will coordinate with the customer after we lock the redlines.
